# Mobile Field Service

> Offline-first phone app for field work (React Native + Couchbase Lite). Official site.

Live: https://mobile.fuj.io/
Application: https://github.com/Fujio-Turner/mobile_field_service
Site source: https://github.com/Fujio-Turner/mobile_field_service_pages
License: Apache-2.0

## Product

Sync today’s jobs or orders, chat with the team, write notes, find assets or customers on a map, and search a local catalog — including with no signal. Copy-on-write: inbound dispatch tickets are never patched; the field app writes outbound copies. No credit card payment in this version.

Three modes (`users.workModes[]`): assets (Jon Hale), customer (Maya Chen), sales (Priya Shah).
